holidays.name: Wonderful Weirdos Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate being yourself, whether that means mismatched socks, odd habits, or a taste for pickles on pancakes. Today, normal is optional and quirks are welcome.
holidays.origin: Novelty-holiday creators Thomas and Ruth Roy of Wellcat Holidays promoted it, starting around 2000. It grew out of the 'Keep Austin Weird' spirit of Austin, Texas, and was widened into an observance for weirdos everywhere.
holidays.funFact: The holiday was first going to be called 'Keep Austin Weird', after Austin's well-known local slogan, before it got a name that anyone could use.

holidays.name: National When Pigs Fly Day
holidays.description: A day for the impossible and the improbable. Celebrate by finally trying something you've always said you'd do 'when pigs fly'. Winged-pig decorations and bacon-themed snacks are optional, though encouraged.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It plays on the old saying that something will happen 'when pigs fly'.
holidays.funFact: Versions of the 'when pigs fly' saying have been around for centuries. An early form, 'pigs may fly, but they are very unlikely birds', is often traced to Scotland.

holidays.name: Teddy Bear Day
holidays.description: A cuddly day to hug your favorite stuffed bear, give one as a gift, or dust off the tattered old friend in the closet. Bears of every size, color, and level of fuzziness are invited.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It honors the teddy bear, one of the world's best-loved toys.
holidays.funFact: The teddy bear is named after U.S. President Theodore 'Teddy' Roosevelt. A famous 1902 cartoon of him refusing to shoot a captive bear inspired the toy.
